To Reinforce Change Talk
Perhaps the client has recently made several statements indicating an inter-
est in change. You, as the practitioner, would like to summarize the change 
talk you hear. For example:
“While you still have concerns about the time it takes to buy fresh produce 
on a regular basis, you have a general interest in trying out the farmers’ 
market. You mentioned that you even looked into the dates, times, and 
locations of farmers’ markets in our area. You’ve shared that this style 
of shopping may get you to eat more fruits and vegetables, which you 
believe might help improve your health in a number of ways. What are 
some other reasons you can think of to try out the farmer’s market?”
